InventoryBatchItemReservation.name: InventoryBatchItemReservation
InventoryBatchItemReservation.description: Represents the inventory reservation for a specific product batch associated with a given item reservation source.

InventoryItemReservationId.description: The inventory item reservation associated with this batch reservation.

IsAutoReserved.description: Indicates whether the reservation was automatically generated or manually entered by a user.

ProductBatchItemId.description: The product batch item associated with the reservation, specifying the product, batch, and location details used.

ProductItemId.description: The product item associated with the serialized product.

Quantity.description: The quantity of the product batch item reserved.

ReservationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the inventory reservation was created.

ReservationItemSourceId.description: The order line item for which the reservation was created.

Status.description: The status of the inventory reservation.
